# Copilot Instructions for presidio-amplify

## Project Overview

`presidio-amplify` is a project that integrates [Microsoft Presidio](https://microsoft.github.io/presidio/) with [AWS Amplify](https://aws.amazon.com/amplify/). Presidio provides PII (Personally Identifiable Information) detection, anonymization, and de-identification capabilities. The goal of this project is to make it easy to deploy and use Presidio services via AWS Amplify.

## Repository Structure

This is an early-stage project. As code is added, the structure is expected to include:

- Source code for Presidio-Amplify integrations
- Infrastructure-as-code (e.g., AWS CDK or Amplify config)
- Tests

## Coding Guidelines

- Use clear, descriptive variable and function names.
- Prefer explicit over implicit behavior.
- Keep functions small and focused on a single responsibility.
- Write tests for all new functionality.
- Document public APIs with docstrings or comments.

## Building and Testing

- When build and test scripts are added, run them before submitting changes.
- Follow the language/framework conventions used in the project.
